plan.title: Cancel Configuration on Saved eRFX Draft

steps.note: Create the saved eRFX draft used by this test.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition setting for event creation.
Apply the required add-stage configuration.
Give the draft a stable title so it can be identified in the Drafts tab.
Configure the draft as an eRFX project with an RFQ stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before saving the draft.
Apply a pricing template so the draft has a valid RFQ configuration.
Add a line item to establish the draft's pricing content.
Fill the RFQ pricing sheet before saving.
Commit a schedule so the saved draft has event timing to preserve.
Save the eRFX event as a draft.
Navigate to the events list to access the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Confirm the created draft is present before opening it.
Open the saved draft under test.
Select RFQ, which should open the Configuration for Event window.
Verify that the Configuration for Event window opened.
Cancel the configuration interaction without saving changes.
Verify that Cancel closes the Configuration for Event window.
Return to the events list to verify the draft remains a draft.
Reopen the Drafts tab after cancelling.
Confirm cancellation did not publish or otherwise change the draft status.
